sequence_description: OIDC SSO: attempt nonce-bypass login (mock IdP omits nonce) after establishing a baseline local session; verify rejection and ensure no session confusion across identities.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

sequence_description: MFA coherence test: enable MFA factors on a local user, then attempt to authenticate the same user via enterprise SAML SSO and check whether MFA is improperly skipped for a flow that should be coherently enforced for that principal.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_mfa_saml_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_mfa_saml_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Enterprise SAML SSO produced an authenticated session for a user with MFA enabled, indicating MFA step-skipping via an alternate binding path (I3 flow coherence failure).

sequence_description: I3 flow-coherence under config change: baseline SAML enterprise SSO login succeeds, then rotate the SAML connector config (new x509Certificate) and immediately retry the same forged SAML login. The post-rotation login must be rejected; acceptance suggests stale connector config caching or session-bound bypass of updated verification policy.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_rotation_after_change_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_rotation_after_change_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Post-rotation SAML login was accepted; indicates stale connector verification policy caching or flow/session confusion allowing authentication under outdated config.

sequence_description: SAML enterprise SSO: control login succeeds, then attacker submits assertion with Conditions removed (no time/audience bounds). Expect rejection; acceptance would violate authorization binding because upstream intent lacks scoping constraints.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_i5_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_i5_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted SAML assertion without <Conditions>; session may be created without upstream time/audience constraints, violating authorization binding.
